input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

1. Verify that the primary Kubernetes cluster in AWS us-east-1 is completely unresponsive to external health check probes.
2. Confirm that regional network route tables have isolated the degraded data center to prevent split-brain partition anomalies.
3. Inspect replication lag metrics on the secondary PostgreSQL cluster in GCP us-central-1 ensuring replication lag is under 50 milliseconds.
4. Promote the GCP standby database cluster to read-write primary status using automated orchestration scripts.
5. Update Cloudflare global traffic management DNS records pointing api.production.internal to the newly promoted GCP ingress gateway IP address.
6. Modify application configuration secrets in Vault updating database connection endpoints and credential leases for worker services.
7. Restart all background Celery task workers across the secondary cluster to establish fresh connection pools with the promoted primary database.
8. Verify that active API gateway proxy pods return healthy HTTP 200 responses on internal health endpoints.
9. Validate that distributed Redis cache clusters in the secondary region have pre-warmed key session entries from persistent RDB snapshots.
10. Initiate continuous change data capture synchronization streaming database mutations to cold backup replicas in Azure east-us.
11. Enable consumer group subscriptions on Apache Kafka event brokers resuming payment event streaming without message offset skips.
12. Notify the emergency incident commander and customer support leadership on the incident Slack channel that primary services are restored.
13. Monitor p99 API latency on Grafana dashboards keeping end-to-end response times below 25 milliseconds across all edge locations.
14. Execute automated synthetic transaction smoke tests verifying that simulated user checkouts complete successfully in under 2 seconds.
15. Audit access log streams in Elasticsearch verifying that no unauthorized authentication requests bypassed security firewalls during DNS propagation.
16. Generate an immutable post-incident audit summary in incident_log.md documenting failover timeline timestamps and error rates.

In addition the database reliability engineering lead mandates monitoring write amplification factors keeping storage IOPS within provisioned limits. Site reliability engineers must ensure that automated Prometheus alerts notify on-call personnel if secondary database replication lag exceeds 200 milliseconds. The Chief Information Security Officer requires verified automated encryption key rotation confirming that all transferred database volumes enforce AES-256 encryption at rest. The enterprise infrastructure platform director requires continuous post-failover stability testing verifying zero dropped database transactions over the subsequent 4 hours before closing the incident room.
17. Inspect distributed trace propagation across Envoy ingress meshes verifying zero trace header drops.
18. Check database connection pool exhaustion alarms verifying that available connections remain above 50%.
19. Initiate automated consistency checks on Redis cache replicas verifying key space parity with the primary cluster.
20. Verify that edge CDN point-of-presence caches invalidate stale static assets within 30 seconds of DNS updates.
21. Validate that scheduled cron jobs in Kubernetes resume execution on the newly active cluster.
22. Inspect asynchronous dead-letter queues in Amazon SQS verifying zero unhandled payment processing events.
23. Check cloud storage replication metrics ensuring multi-region object parity within 60 seconds.
24. Verify that internal service mesh mTLS certificates remain valid across all communication boundaries.
25. Monitor host CPU utilization across worker nodes ensuring peak load stays below 70%.
26. Execute end-to-end user checkout simulations verifying payment gateway response times under 1 second.
27. Verify that automated backup snapshots execute on schedule across all secondary database nodes.
28. Inspect system audit logs verifying that all operator commands executed during the failover were cryptographically signed.
29. Confirm that public status page incident notifications update customer stakeholders every 15 minutes.
30. Review cross-region network egress costs verifying bandwidth usage remains within allocated disaster recovery budgets.
31. Conduct automated smoke tests across third-party webhook integrations confirming zero webhook delivery failures.
32. Archive the completed incident chronology and system performance metrics in `postmortem_archive.tar.gz`.
33. Conduct automated network latency probes across all regional cross-connect links verifying round-trip times remain under 20 milliseconds.
34. Inspect container resource limits across the cluster ensuring memory reservations are strictly honored by the scheduler.
35. Verify that centralized logging daemons stream event records to S3 cold storage without buffer backpressure.
36. Confirm that automated snapshot lifecycle rules retain hourly snapshots for 7 days and daily snapshots for 30 days.
37. Validate that internal domain certificates renew automatically via `cert-manager` without service interruption.
38. Inspect queue depth on Redis background job queues ensuring worker throughput exceeds incoming event arrival rates.
39. Verify that database index bloat remains below 10% following high-volume write failover traffic.
40. Obtain written operational sign-off from the lead reliability engineer and close the active incident tracking bridge.
41. Confirm that all post-incident remediation items are assigned to designated engineering leads in Jira before standing down the emergency operations team."}]
